notes.title: Gunbrella’s release date sees its Murdery Poppins float down to shoot monsters in the face later this month
notes.notes:
Gunbrella continues to look top-notch, the side-scrolling action-adventure serving up a does-what-it-says-on-the-tin approach to combining the floaty platforming of an umbrella with the shoot-everything-in-the-face simplicity of a gun. Now we know when we’ll be able to actually play it - and it’s soon!

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes:
The answer to the long burning question is finally here!

[h3]September 13 is the release date of Gunbrella![/h3]
[i]Your hard-nosed investigation soon becomes entangled with the inner workings of a creepy cabal of ghouls and gangsters, cops and cultists, and the fallout of corporate exploitation.[/i]

https://youtu.be/XWWtajLd_0c

Pre-order now and receive Doinksoft’s critically-acclaimed debut Gato Roboto for free.

We also prepared a new demo as an appetizer for you until the full game arrives, can you spot the differences between the new and old demo? Let us know!
